mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_frame ( source_time TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '源时间', task_id STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '任务编号', interface_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '采集接口主键', source_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '来源类型', source_identity STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '设备或远程组合身份', telemetry_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '遥测类型', device_satellite_name STRING COMMENT '设备卫星名称', channel_name STRING COMMENT '通道名称', `raw` BINARY COMMENT '完整采集报文', check_status STRING INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '帧检查状态编码', TIME INDEX (source_time), PRIMARY KEY (task_id, interface_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type) ) WITH ('append_mode'='false', 'merge_mode'='last_row', 'ttl'='forever')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_parameter ( source_time TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '源时间', task_id STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '任务编号', source_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '来源类型', source_identity STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '设备或远程组合身份', telemetry_type STRING NOT NULL COMMENT '遥测类型', telemetry_code STRING NOT NULL INVERTED INDEX COMMENT '遥测代号', telemetry_name STRING COMMENT '参数名称', value_type STRING COMMENT '遥测值类型编码', `value` DOUBLE COMMENT '遥测数值', value_text STRING COMMENT '遥测值文本原文', `raw` BINARY COMMENT '参数原码', state_name STRING COMMENT '参数状态名称原文', state_type STRING COMMENT '参数状态类型编码', state_index INT COMMENT '参数状态索引', processed_at TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '处理时间', TIME INDEX (source_time), PRIMARY KEY (task_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type, telemetry_code) ) WITH ('append_mode'='false', 'merge_mode'='last_row', 'ttl'='forever')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_frame (source_time, task_id, interface_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type, device_satellite_name, channel_name, `raw`, check_status) VALUES (#{sourceTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{interfaceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sourceIdentity,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{telemetryType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceSatelliteName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{channelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{raw,jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{checkStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO telemetry_parameter (source_time, task_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type, telemetry_code, telemetry_name, value_type, `value`, value_text, `raw`, state_name, state_type, state_index, processed_at) VALUES
(#{row.sourceTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{row.taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.sourceIdentity,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.telemetryType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.telemetryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.telemetryName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.valueType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.value,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{row.valueText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.raw,jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{row.stateName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.stateType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.stateIndex,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{row.processedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select:
SELECT source_time, task_id, interface_id, source_type, source_identity, telemetry_type, device_satellite_name, channel_name, `raw`, check_status FROM telemetry_frame
ORDER BY source_time DESC, interface_id ASC, source_type ASC, source_identity ASC, telemetry_type ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
